evals.name: Distributed Rate Limiter
evals.prompt: Create a technical document for a distributed rate limiter that supports multiple strategies (Token Bucket, Leaky Bucket) and can handle high throughput with low latency.
evals.expected_output: A concise technical document following the modular structure, including Kroki diagrams, BDD tests, and pseudocode, with minimal interface code.

evals.name: Image Upload Service
evals.prompt: Design a technical document for an image upload and processing service. Users upload images, which are then resized and stored in S3. The system should notify the user when processing is complete.
evals.expected_output: A data-flow-centric document showing the path from upload to S3 and notification, with diagrams and BDD tests.
